about.title: 关于我们
about.subtitle: Elif Games
about.description: Elif Games是个人独立游戏工作室，在创作中以“Else If”为核心理念。
about.missionText:
“ELIF”是部分编程语言中“另一种如果”的关键词，同时也是单词“LIFE”的易位词。
生命中总会有很多隐藏的暗门，而我们希望将游戏做成钥匙。

One day, you too will sit atop the President's desk.

about.missionText:
ELIF is the keyword for “another if” in some programming languages—and an anagram of LIFE.
Life hides secret doors everywhere, we create games to become the keys.
